desktopDevice.description: Account-bound zd_ device credential, only /api/bot/local endpoints

api_key.description: Omit or leave blank to retain saved secret

dimensions.description: Embedding requires 1..2000; unused for other model types

config_id.description: Media profile ID; omit for legacy default provider. New UUID rows do not inherit any saved key.

document_ids.description: Restrict search to authorized, fully indexed attachments
Answer using these authorized, fully indexed attachments; knowledge tools stay within this selection

allow_web.description: Allow Pi Agent to use public web tools for this turn; also subject to administrator AGENT_WEB_ENABLED policy

image_model_id.description: Enabled image profile from own tenant capability catalog; omit for default

video_model_id.description: Enabled video profile from own tenant capability catalog; omit for default

mask_attachment_id.description: RGBA PNG matching the first reference image; transparent areas are edited

plugin_ids.description: Own installed and enabled Harness bundle or Cordis plugin names; unavailable plugins fail before queuing

MemorySettingsInput.description: Update only supplied preferences; omitted fields retain their saved values. skill_capture controls new skill proposals/extractions, not review or use of existing skills.

config.description: Official Cordis row ID to configuration object; empty object resets configuration
